text: もってる　だけじゃ　ダメだよ

structure.jp: もってる　だけじゃ

patterns.name: 〜ではだめだ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the casual form of では, and with ダメだ it says 'that way is no good'. だけじゃ　ダメだ = 'just that is no good'.

patterns.name: 〜だけ
patterns.explanation: だけ after a verb means 'only doing that and nothing more'. もってる　だけ = 'just having them'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている shows a lasting state. てる is the casual shortened form. もってる = 'have, are holding'.
